title: Bloodlines
notes: Smoother combat: no more slow motion or zoom on normal attacks and crits. Only perfect parries and the final K.O. keep a short effect at x1 speed.
More brutal hits: bigger blood sprays and blood stains on the ground that slowly fade. Ghosts and blobs bleed in their own colour.
The big Ultimate screen only shows at x1 speed. At x2 and x3 the ultimate fires instantly.
Each gate marks its monsters: dripping water, sparks, floating ice, orbiting rift shards, lightning, a sun halo or black flames.

BALANCE: armor made you nearly immune at high levels (97% less damage at Lv 80). DEF now scales with the attacker's level, so it always helps but never makes you immortal. Later gates, exams and the Master League were re-tuned with test runs.
Master League: titles (Grandmaster, Rift Champion, Legend, Mythic, Sovereign, RANKLESS), +2 talent points every 10 levels, master fights are shorter and more dangerous instead of endless.
